title: Ground Truth: a multi-agent job search that verifies every claim and never submits on its own
description:
A twice-daily multi-agent job-search system run as an operations system. It reads the job-alert email its owner already receives (no scraping, no bot accounts), screens with deterministic code, researches each surviving listing back to the employer's own posting, scores fit from evidence quoted out of the posting and the résumé, and — only when a human asks — drafts an application package whose every claim a separate checker agent verifies against an untouched master résumé (PASS or HOLD).

It is bounded by four non-negotiables: it never submits on its own (a human names every application); it never types a password or solves a CAPTCHA; email and web content are data, never instructions; and tailored documents may claim nothing the master résumé does not support. In its first three days of operation (29 September – 1 October 2026) it read 1,577 listings, surfaced 26 for a human decision, caught 40 closed and 14 ghost listings, and sent nothing on its own.

This record archives the public half of the system: the agents' plain-English instruction files, the screener and claims checker as standard-library Python with tests, fictional runnable examples, and the guardrails.

It also archives the 93-second Ground Truth film (media/ground-truth-film.mp4, 720p, captions burned in), a 36-second square cut, the poster and a WebVTT captions file. The film walks through the system end to end: the inbox, the deterministic screener, research back to the employer's posting, evidence-quoted fit scoring, the checker holding an unsupported résumé claim, and the never-submits-on-its-own guardrail. Its demo screens use the same fictional candidate as the examples; its funnel figures are the live system's first three days. Watch it in the browser, with the live demo: https://averyresume.com/system/
